scenes.title: A boat and a warning at pier four
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn offers a daylight boat ride for two silver and says she will be at pier four tomorrow at first light. She claims Saltmere Mine flooded when the bell first rang forty years ago, with warm water.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: The party finds warm floodwater and hymn pages, including one marked "M. Brand" that Teo identifies as his sister Mira's handwriting. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement; the search reveals nothing else, and Oren takes two damage from the bad air.

scenes.title: The midnight bell
scenes.place: Shore below the drowned chapel, Gullwick
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn that the Kelp Mother takes children near the water. At midnight the underwater bell rings twelve times, the humming grows louder, and pale figures appear in rows on the chapel floor before vanishing; the GM notes the choir clock is at three of six.

scenes.title: A plan at the Tarred Gull
scenes.summary: The party plans to have Sela row them out at first light and dive to the chapel at low tide; Vessa says she will buy rope and another lantern. Bram says Maren lost a brother to the bay, and the party takes a long rest and returns to full health.
